'''Voth Vassakka''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Republic soldier|soldier]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Special Forces Division|Special Forces Division]] who fought against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] at the [[Battle of Corellia]], where the [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] held the Republic's supply schedule for [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]. Given the schedule's critical value as military intelligence, Vassakka was lured out and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial forces]].

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Jedipedia" /> [[Republic soldier|soldier]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Voth Vassakka<ref name="Break the Lines" /> underwent training at the [[Republic Army Special Forces Academy]] to become a member of the elite [[Republic Special Forces Division|Special Forces Division]].<ref name="SpecForce" /> The [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] held the Republic's supply schedule for the contested<ref name="Break the Lines" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Coronet City}}</ref> [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]]<ref name="Time" /> during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. As part of the [[Battle of Corellia]], the Empire deemed the schedule to be a crucial piece of intelligence for their ongoing assault on the Republic-held [[Governmental Sector|government district]] in<ref name="Break the Lines" /> the Corellian [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]].<ref name="Codex" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Operating under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Hestun]],<ref name="Precision Strikes">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Precision Strikes|Corellia}}</ref> an individual affiliated with the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial forces]] sought to claim the schedule,<ref name="Break the Lines" /> battling through [[Anti-aircraft gun|anti-aircraft]] emplacements in the district<ref name="Precision Strikes" /> before proceeding to [[Slicer/Legends|slice]] into a ground-level Republic [[Computer/Legends|console]] near Vassakka's position. The [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] then descended to the ground using a [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] to confront the intruder alone. Vassakka was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the assailant in the ensuing brawl, and the victor claimed the Republic supply schedule and subsequently handed it over to the nearby [[Imperial Central Command (Corellia)|Imperial Central Command]].<ref name="Break the Lines" />
{{Endgame}}

==Equipment==
[[File:CryoGrenadeTOR.png|thumb|right|54px|A cryo [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] used by the trooper]]
Voth Vassakka wore a set of [[Color/Legends|white]]<ref name="Break the Lines" /> Republic Special Forces trooper<ref name="SpecForce" /> [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that sported blue markings with brown accents and a [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]] piece affixed to his left shoulder, while the right shoulder pad was adorned with the [[Republic crest|emblem]] of the Republic. Donning a [[Bandolier/Legends|bandolier]] and a jetpack, the soldier fought with an [[Assault cannon/Legends|assault cannon]], a [[Railgun/Legends|rail gun]], and [[CryoBan grenade/Legends|cryo grenades]].<ref name="Break the Lines" />

==Behind the scenes==
Voth Vassakka appeared in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The character spawns as an enemy boss in the final stage of "Break the Lines,"<ref name="Break the Lines" /> an optional bonus mission of the Imperial quest "Precision Strikes."<ref name="Precision Strikes" />
